_comment: EXTERNAL ground truth, hand-checked against the live game / published stats.
This file is the real accuracy gate: it is NOT generated from the game files,
so it independently pins the ingestion chain (milli-tile units, the shared
power ladder, the rarity offset, truncation, projectile damage lookup).
Add an entry only when you have actually confirmed the number. Never
regenerate this file from a build -- that would make the gate circular.
'display_level' is the rarity-independent level the game shows (11 = tournament standard).

Knight._source: confirmed: 1,766 HP, 202 damage per hit, 168 DPS, 1.2s hit speed, 3 elixir Common

Pekka._source: 3760 HP confirmed live; damage 842 established by interaction breakpoints (see tests/test_interactions.py)

ArcherQueen._source: champion rarity offset check: base 391 at power index 0 x2.56 = 1000 at display 11

Rocket._source: well-established tournament-standard value; pins the spell projectile-damage path

Arrows._source: 122 is PER PROJECTILE. Arrows lands 3 waves of 10 projectiles 200ms apart, so a stationary target takes more than this.

Fireball._source: tournament-standard damage, 2.5-tile radius, reduced crown-tower damage

Zap._source: tournament-standard 192 damage; pins the area-effect damage path

Lightning._source: tournament-standard 1057; pins the area-effect -> projectile chain

Poison._source: tournament-standard 92 damage/second over 8s; pins the buff DoT path

IceWizard._source: tournament-standard 688 HP / 89 damage; pins the same-name character fallback

ThreeMusketeers._source: reworked card; 3 units from an explicit SummonCharactersList

engine_constants._comment: Structural facts read out of the game files and cross-checked against live play.
engine_constants._geometry_source: tilemaps/tilemap.csv from the APK, 36x64 half-tile bitfield; 141 of 158 arena rows use it
engine_constants._footprint_source: BLOCKED region in tilemap.csv at cells x15-20,y3-8; PrincessTower has no blocked footprint and uses CollisionRadius=1000 (1 tile)

open_questions.question: P.E.K.K.A damage at display level 11: extracted data gives 842; some public stat sites report 510.
open_questions.resolution: 842 is correct. A same-level Musketeer has 721 HP, and P.E.K.K.A one-shotting a Musketeer is a well-established interaction that 510 cannot produce. The breakpoint also cuts the other way correctly: 842 does NOT one-shot a 1766 HP Knight, which matches play. The public 510 figure is stale. Locked in by tests/test_interactions.py.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: (kept for provenance) read Damage on the in-game card page.

open_questions.question: Arrows deals 122 per projectile across 3 waves of 10. How many waves actually land on one stationary unit, and does the in-game 'Damage' figure show per-wave or total?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Decides whether Arrows clears 230 HP Minions, which is its defining use. Affects any spell with ProjectileWaves or MultipleProjectiles (Arrows, Hunter, Princess).
open_questions.how_to_resolve: M5 models waves explicitly; then assert Arrows clears a Minion Horde and Hunter's point-blank burst kills what it should. Until then do not treat `damage` on these three as a single hit.

open_questions.question: Do Crown Towers scale on the card PowerLevelMultiplier ladder, or on their own per-level percentage?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Tower hitpoints set every damage race in the game. cr-sim currently applies the card ladder, giving Princess 3584 / King 6144 at level 11, which is very likely too high.
open_questions.evidence: globals.csv carries a separate tower progression the cards do not use: HITPOINT_INCREASE_PERCENT_PER_TOWER_LEVEL=8, HITPOINT_INCREASE_PERCENT_PER_KING_LEVEL=7, *_AFTER_TOURNAMENTCAP=10, *_AT_TOURNAMENTCAP=10, TOWER_SCALING_START_EXP_LEVEL=9. A flat +8%/level on the level-1 base gives Princess 2520 at level 11 instead of 3584.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Read Princess and King Tower hitpoints off the in-game tower card at a known King level, then fit which of the candidate formulas reproduces it. Must be settled in M2, when towers start fighting.
open_questions.resolution: Towers are NOT on the card ladder. They accumulate a flat percentage of their level-1 base: 8%/level for a Princess Tower, 7% for the King, switching to 10%/level past TOWER_SCALING_START_EXP_LEVEL=9. Two independent supports: the globals themselves, and published descriptions of tower progression stating '+8% per level from 1 to 9, +10% from 9 to 13'. A third check falls out for free - published tower hitpoints are all divisible by 14, which this formula reproduces automatically for every level (1400 x integer%/100), and the card ladder does not. Level 11: Princess 2576, King 4224. The card ladder gave 3584, a 39% error.

open_questions.question: Are the bridges 2 or 3 tiles wide?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Bridge width sets how many units can cross abreast and how spells cover a crossing push.
open_questions.evidence: Every non-event tilemap in build 150535029 has 2-tile bridges (cells x5-8 and x27-30 across all four river rows), and 141 of 158 arena rows point at that one tilemap. Public descriptions say 2 tiles in Arenas 1-6 and 8-9 but 3 tiles in Arenas 7 and 10-23, which this build's data does not reproduce anywhere.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Likely the public figure describes the visual bridge art, or predates a geometry unification. If a future APK extraction shows a 3-tile tilemap, tests/test_arena_and_battle.py::test_bridges_are_two_tiles_wide_in_this_build will fail and flag it.

open_questions.question: Do buildings collide as squares or as circles?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Decides whether a unit can clip a building's corner, and how tightly troops pack around a Cannon or Tombstone. Affects every surround and every building-block placement.
open_questions.evidence: The King Tower's blocked footprint in tilemap.csv is a clean 3.0x3.0 tile SQUARE (cells x15-20, y3-8), not a disc, and buildings are placed on tile centres. But the only per-entity extent in the data is CollisionRadius, a single scalar (KingTower 1400, PrincessTower 1000), which is circular by nature. PrincessTower has no blocked footprint at all. cr-sim's fixed.circles_overlap currently treats everything as a circle.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: M3 (collision). Test by walking a troop diagonally at a Cannon's corner and comparing where it stops against the real game.
